from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single legal document with its identifying and legal classification details."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of the legal document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书)")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Broad category of the case (e.g., 刑事，民事，行政)")
    cause_or_charge: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or criminal charge stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
